system.description:
With your weapon in hand, you stab forward at an increasingly chaotic pace fast enough to create the appearance of afterimages as each strike attempts to strike a slightly different part of the target from a slightly different angle. Make two melee taijutsu attacks. On a hit, you deal your [Weapons Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] + 1d6. If at least one of these attacks hits a creature, the target must make a Strength saving throw, being knocked prone on a failed save and you can move 10 feet into any direction of your choice.

Battle Lust: By spending 1 Battle Lust as part of this jutsu’s casting, these attacks are compared to the AC of all creatures of your choice within your weapons range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, on a failed save the target is also pushed 10 feet in any direction of your choice. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, this jutsu’s casting time can be 1 Reaction that you take when a creature triggers your attack of opportunity.
